scenario: [LEXP.3.7.4]: the compiler refuses a `bits`, `sign_extend` or `swap_bytes` call whose compile-time constant arguments ([LEXP.8.8]) place it outside [LEXP.3.7.3]'s domain whatever its other arguments hold. `s.x.swap_bytes(24)`, the clause's own example: [LEXP.3.7.3] admits a width of 16, 32 or 64 only, so 24 is DS_VALIDATE_BIT_FIELD_RANGE for every receiver. One refusal per vector, so this one cannot pass on another call's diagnostic. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.lexp_3_7_4_bit_field_range`'s `swap_bytes` arm. Twins: LEXP.3.7.4_sign_extend_width_refused, LEXP.3.7.4_constant_out_of_range_refused (`bits`).
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    id: String key
    x: Int mutable

rule r:
    Sensor s where s.x.swap_bytes(24) > 0
->
    log info "x"
